See [[Template:HelmetDatesFR|this page]] for instructions on how to properly use the template.</span>}}}}</includeonly><noinclude>This template is to be used for citing the French release dates of individual issues of [[De Agostini]]'s ''[[Star Wars Helmet Collection]]''.

==Usage==
Copy-paste the following code and replace "NUMBER" with the appropriate issue number.
 <nowiki>{{</nowiki>HelmetDatesFR|''NUMBER''}}

===Example===
 <nowiki>{{HelmetDatesFR|75}}</nowiki>
*{{HelmetDatesFR|75}}
